answer: Require each identity to lock a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long, sequential proof-of-work delay: a gale of cheap clones then costs real capital and unparallelizable time. Identities earn standing only through repeated, attested work, so a fresh clone starts on a bare knoll with no history. Peers also cross-check behaviour: an identity whose answers merely echo others without original contribution is flagged and its stake slashed. Cloning stops paying, because each extra identity costs a full stake plus weeks of delay for near-zero gain.
